caption: The drawing features a detailed and colorful depiction of a brown bonnet or hat as the central object, adorned with two birds that have blue and green plumage and long, thin feather plumes. The hat is embellished with pink flowers and green leaves on one side, with a ribbon extending below. The main condensed section inside the hat is shaded in dark brown and black. There are small white flowers or decorative elements near the base of the birds. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there are two lightly sketched outlines: one is a profile of a woman's head wearing the same decorated bonnet, and the other is a frontal design sketch of the bonnet, both rendered in simple pencil lines without color. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Brown Velvet Cap
